title: Think Before You Forecast: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.29566v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time compute has become an important paradigm in computer vision and language modeling, where additional computation at inference time enables models to explore multiple candidate solutions and select or refine the most reliable one. However, time series forecasting models typically produce predictions through a single forward pass, leaving them vulnerable to distribution shifts and non-stationarity that frequently arise in real-world temporal data. We propose Time Test Compute for Time Series (TTC4TS), an architecture-agnostic framework that improves the predictive performance of frozen forecasting models at inference time. Given a pretrained backbone, the generator produces multiple candidate forecast trajectories using augmentation, retrieval, adapter. The synthesizer then selects or combines these candidates using aggregation, classification, or candidate-scoring and ranking methods to produce the final forecast. By increasing

translated_title: 预测之前先思考：为时间序列预测扩展测试时计算
translated_abstract: 测试时计算已成为计算机视觉和语言建模中的一种重要范式，在推理时进行额外的计算能够使模型探索多个候选解决方案，并选择或优化其中最可靠的一个。然而，时间序列预测模型通常通过单次前向传播来产生预测，这使得它们容易受到真实世界时间数据中频繁出现的分布偏移和非平稳性的影响。我们提出了面向时间序列的时间测试计算（TTC4TS），这是一个与架构无关的框架，能够在推理时提升冻结的预测模型的预测性能。给定一个预训练的主干网络，生成器利用数据增强、检索、适配器等方法产生多个候选预测轨迹；随后，合成器通过聚合、分类或候选评分与排序等方法对这些候选结果进行选择或组合，从而产生最终的预测。通过增加……
tldr: 提出TTC4TS框架，通过在推理时生成多个候选预测轨迹并进行选择或组合，以测试时计算的方式提升冻结时间序列预测模型的预测性能。
en_tdlr: TTC4TS is an architecture-agnostic test-time compute framework that improves frozen time series forecasting models by generating multiple candidate forecast trajectories at inference and selecting or combining them into a final prediction.
